FormaView's optional CPU raster target uses Qt 6.12.0, libtiff 4.7.2,
libwebp 1.6.0 (including sharpyuv, demux and mux) and zlib 1.3.2.
Their license and patent notices accompany this file. These dependency
licenses do not select or grant a license for FormaView itself.

The desktop thumbnail worker also statically links Qt 6.12.0's bundled
libpng 1.6.58 (Qt6::BundledLibpng, headers Qt6::PngPrivate) for bounded
scanline PNG thumbnails. It uses the existing pinned Qt installation;
no separate libpng runtime DLL is required. The unmodified library's
copyright and license accompany this file in libpng-LICENSE.txt.

Static TIFF codecs deployed here: none, LZW, PackBits, CCITT and Deflate.
JPEG-in-TIFF, LERC, LZMA, ZSTD, JBIG and WebP-in-TIFF are not deployed.
The application separately validates sample types and photometric layouts;
presence of a library codec does not advertise all its variants.

bcdec is an external verification-only decoder, not linked or distributed
with the application. Pillow and tifffile are also verification tools.
